_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Flat-to-slightly-up coil with dead funding and diverging heat factors makes HOLD the base-rate call; no breaker is visible.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst explicitly HOLD/Complacency coil; narrative supplies vol-top color without a directional phase call
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC stays rangebound, fear_greed holds 47-58, funding near flat, no follow-through on the vol spike
next_move.invalidated_if: fear_greed breaks under 40 on a fast selloff (Anxiety) or 30d momentum accelerates with fear_greed above 62 (Disbelief)
